question: Are all client documents and scanned images encrypted at rest?
Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all remote and administrative access?
Do you hold a current SOC 2 Type II report? Please attach.
Do you perform criminal background checks on all employees?
Will you notify us of any security incident affecting our data within 24 hours of discovery?
Has an independent penetration test been performed in the last 12 months? Were all high findings remediated?
Is your information security policy reviewed at least annually?
Do you have a tested business continuity plan covering your storage facilities?
Are physical storage areas protected by access control and CCTV?
Do you securely destroy client records at the end of the retention period and issue a certificate of destruction?
